Tiny the Trooper

This is a composition of Paddy O’Brien, according to my source.

↳ Posted by mallette on February 16th, 2008.

Tiny The Trooper, X:2

A setting for pipes by Tim Britton, who played with Paddy O’Brien in the band Chul Rua.
After the last bar, showing variation leading back into the start of the tune.
Double staccato denotes a tight ‘nipped’ note.

↳ Posted by Glenn Adamson on February 9th, 2024.
